coverage: All edible entries in the pinned survival-world scrapbook, plus prepared and seasoned dishes.
All Recipe/Recipe2 registrations in recipes.lua; construction plans are listed separately.
Crock Pot uses exhaust all four-slot combinations of available ingredient classes, for both pots.
Nutrition is fresh baseline, before character modifiers. Jellybean delayed healing is separate.
Creature feeding, farming, loot, and acquisition chains beyond the registered recipe menus are outside the use graph.
Registered shop recipes are available to inspect, but are not assumed as the source of ordinary crafting materials.
Character skill effects, dynamic yields, and placement rules are flagged; material totals use baseline yields.
Special-diet foods and seasonal foods remain identifiable; separate Forge/Gorge game modes are excluded.
